app.name: Toothbrush
app.summary: Your electric toothbrush live: the zones you brush as a ring, the time, battery and pressure.
app.in_state_hint: The brush's main entity: Oral-B its state sensor, Sonicare its handle state, Xiaomi its toothbrush entity, Laifen its brushing state.
app.in_sector_hint: The sector sensor (Oral-B, Sonicare). Leave it empty for Xiaomi and Laifen: the zones then go by time.
app.in_time_hint: Seconds brushed in this session. Leave it empty when the brush has none: the screen counts itself.
app.in_pressure_hint: The pressure sensor (Oral-B pressure, Sonicare pressure state). Leave it empty when the brush has none.
app.in_mode_hint: The brushing mode: a sensor, or the mode's select.
app.in_head_hint: Oral-B refill days, Sonicare brush head wear, Xiaomi consumable. Choose how to show it in the tile's options.
app.in_last_hint: The last session sensor (a moment), or Xiaomi's score.
app.opt_zones_hint: Auto shows 4 until the brush reports a fifth zone. Choose 6 for a brush that brushes in six from the start.
app.opt_routine_hint: How long a full session takes. It times the zones of a brush without a zone sensor.
app.opt_hold_hint: How many hours the ring shows how the last session went. 0 keeps it until the next one.
app.opt_head_hint: What the brush head entity counts.
